bullets.text: Rainfall has caused potholes to develop across 13,227 locations on Chennai roads, and the office should monitor ongoing repair efforts by the Greater Chennai Corporation.
The Greater Chennai Corporation has fixed 1,531 of the 13,227 rain-damaged potholes, and the office should track the progress of remaining road repairs across the city.

stories.title: Potholes develop on more roads in Chennai owing to rain
takeaways: Heavy rains caused 13227 potholes across 2953 roads throughout Chennai city infrastructure.
Municipal authorities must repair dangerous road damage before public safety issues escalate further.

stories.title: Greater Chennai Corporation fixes 1,531 of 13,227 potholes after rains
takeaways: Greater Chennai Corporation successfully repaired 1531 out of 13227 post rain potholes.
Crews continue fixing damaged bus routes and interior roads to restore proper vehicular movement.

stories.title: City’s AQI stagnation: no new monitors, existing monitors don’t relay data
takeaways: Chennai citizens lack reliable air quality data as state monitors fail and sensors go blank.
The 62 crore sensor network malfunction leaves residents blind during Diwali firecracker smoke.
